    AI Overview
    Country music star Riley Green made his acting debut on the Yellowstone spinoff series Marshals as the character Garrett, a former Navy SEAL with a troubled past. His character first appeared in Episode 8, "Blowback," which premiered on Sunday, April 19, 2026. 
    Role and Character Details 
    • Character: Garrett is a veteran and former Navy SEAL who arrives at Kayce Dutton's (Luke Grimes) ranch unexpectedly.
    • Storyline: He has a history with both Kayce and Cal (Logan Marshall-Green). The character deals with PTSD and "demons of his past".
    • Acting Process: Green worked with real-life Navy SEALs on set to ensure his portrayal was authentic. He also performed his song "My Way" during the episode.
    • Duration: Green is set to appear in a multi-episode arc. 
    Background 
    Green, 37, is best known for his country music career but transitioned into acting for this role, citing Tim McGraw's performance in 1883 as an inspiration. He noted that any negative comments his character makes about Alabama are purely for the drama of the script.
